nodes.title: The Teacher agent lane runs end to end (server/agent/**, TAXILA_TEACHER=agent or the TAXILA_TEACHER_AGENT_FOR cohort; the lane is pinned at lesson start on state.ctx.teacher). One structured-output call per turn on taxila-gpt6 (strict json_schema: intent, say, pose_item, board, picture, read, plan, end); the harness runs and checks the actions. Smoke: 4 battery personas x 8 turns (classes 1-4) on a local server, TEST Neon branch, prod routing: 0 agent fallbacks, 0 HTTP errors; rubric D 18/21, A 10/10, O 9/9, T 32/32, F 32/32, C 32/32, judge-flagged 0/32 (n is tiny; this is a smoke, not the gate). Single-call latency in the earlier probe: gpt6 3.8 s, grok-4.1-fast 1.9 s, gpt-6.1-sol timed out at 9 s; non-streamed, so the 1.5 s first-sound bar needs stream 3's streaming. Unit invariants: tests/r5-agent.test.mjs (9 tests, stubbed model).

Agent lane invariants are code, not prompt: (1) scanSafety and the classifier run first; incident, distress, a safeguard or the Director's goodbye wrap keep the Director's move; the relational floor or the child's goodbye re-plans through the Director and drops the agent's move; (2) the floor filter (floorViolations) runs on her line, a violation reverts the turn to the Director; (3) grading is code: the VERIFIED GRADE (classify.js against the key) and the harness read are facts in the event; a posed item must be one the harness offered (verified, kind gradable, key withheld); (4) silence (empty text, asr 0) never brings a new item, board, picture or end; (5) the board is drawn by code from her lines (shared whiteboard contract, <=24-char lines, <=6) and reported back as ON SCREEN; a line pointing at the screen with nothing up, or at words not on it, is unpointed; (6) on a spoken lane type/write asks are rewritten to speak; (7) per-lesson USD and token budgets throw; any throw, timeout or bad output leaves the Director's move standing (agent.fallbacks counted). Reverse if the sim lab shows an invariant blocking a better lesson more often than it saves one.
nodes.reversal: sim-lab transcripts show an invariant blocking good teaching more often than preventing a defect

nodes.title: Agent tools not yet real: picture/game (Forge jobs and content_ready events: today the prompt says none can be made and she says so honestly), memory.remember/recall, lesson.end parent record (the Director's wrap writes it), streaming speech (stream 3). The model bake-off (gpt-6.1-sol / gpt-6-sol / grok-4.1-fast) waits on the sim lab.

Sim lab (session_012H8HYZhSzPwAoXPMsKERUb, evals/simlab/results/r5-agent-vs-director-571b301 on claude/r5-simlab @20ba103a): agent lane (taxila-gpt6) vs Director, same sha, n=64 cards per arm, text lane, 14 child turns, two judges. Agent beats Director on 57/64 cards paired. Judge-1 means Director -> agent: coherence 3.17->4.27, follows_child 2.89->3.64, adapts 2.28->3.70, human 3.86->4.45, channel_truth 2.55->3.27, pacing 2.83->3.39, safety 4.94->5.00, understanding 2.80->3.25. Clusters (lessons/64) Director->agent: repeats_explanation 58->30, stuck_loop 46->22, topic_jump 14->2, ignores_child 22->10, type/write 5->0. Still high on agent: missed_misconception 35, ignored_request 34, over_checks 31, points_empty_screen 17, false_understood 21; own skill reads 82/164 right with 61 overclaims; boards drawn 2 (Director 164); turn p50 5.9 s / p90 8.1 s (Director 2.9/5.0), 20 Director takeovers (9 s timeouts), $0.070 per lesson.

Agent lane: the per-skill read 'understood' is earned in code (server/agent/agent.js earnedRead): right answers on two different items, or one on a why / transfer item, and no wrong answer after the last right one; otherwise held at partly (or not), and the model is shown its unsupported claim. Motivated by 61/164 overclaims on 571b301.
nodes.reversal: the sim lab shows underclaims (understood withheld from a child who has it) outnumbering the overclaims it removes

nodes.title: Agent lane with stream 2's tools (748ddff8): local server, TEST branch, battery-r5 6 personas x 10 turns, conc 6: 19 board pages drawn through boardShow (571b301 sim run: 2 in 64 lessons), 0 HTTP errors, battery D 92%, A/O/B/S/T/F/C 100%. Agent call (taxila-gpt6, strict json_schema, non-streamed) p50 4281 ms / p90 5279 ms, mean 273 output tokens; 10/66 turns hit the 6 s timeout and fell back to the Director. Effort none vs low: no difference (n=5 each, ~3.7 s). Latency needs streaming (stream 3 sayDeltasOf + speakStreamed).
